# Home Sim Hub
> UK guides to home golf bays, launch monitor brands and sim racing rigs. Last updated 2026-11-24.

Home Sim Hub publishes factual UK buying and room-sizing guides for home golf simulator bays and sim racing rigs. Every measurement and specification is cited from manufacturers' manuals, official UK product pages, and Amazon UK listings checked on 24 Nov 2026. We do not test products hands-on and do not publish star ratings or review scores.
